taunt: The mop has seen worse than you.
I do not talk much. The mop talks.
Olives on everything. Even you.
I was folded in a bag. I unfolded. You will fold.
The mop reaches. You do not.
The possum found a napkin. The napkin found a mop. The mop found you.
Sporke talks for both of us. The mop hits for both of us.
The floor is wet. That is my sign. It is also my mop.
I lift the pizza. Whole. Box and all. Then I lift you.
Quiet ones hit hard. I am very quiet.
My headband tears every fight. I fold a new one. I have a stack.
The mop is a bo-staff. The bucket is at home.
I can reach the top shelf. I can reach you. Same arm.
Deep dish is a pizza. Lidd is wrong. The mop agrees.
You are small and loud. I am large and not.
Everything in the sewer is on the floor. I know where it is. I mop it.
I folded a rat once. It asked me to. Long story.
Olives are a vegetable, a fruit and a weapon. Three things. Like me.
Do not touch the headband. The headband is the last clean thing I own.
I have the reach. You have the regret.
I do not do flips either. I do not need to. The mop flips.
Napkin. Not a towel. Not a rag. The possum was very specific.
The mop head is not hair. People ask. People stop asking.
Big gecko. Long stick. Short fight.
I mop the pipe every Sunday. You are a Tuesday problem.
I could fold you into a swan. I will fold you into the floor.
Lidd says I lift trucks. I lifted one truck. It was a toy. It was heavy.
I grab. I lift. I put down. Hard.
The mop handle is wood. The wood is tired. Not as tired as you will be.
I speak when it matters. This matters. Fall down.
My tail is longer than your arm. The mop is longer than your plan.
Strawe spits. Sporke pokes. Lidd slaps. I sweep.
I eat olives by the jar. The jar is the snack. Olives are the meal.
Stand back. Farther. The mop goes that far.
I wring the mop. I wring you. Same wrist.
I am embarrassed by compliments. You will not be giving any.
The headband says NAPKIN. I wrote it. The possum cannot write.
Four geckos. I carry three of them when they are tired. Every day.
I swept the sewer once. It took a year. I found a couch. Lidd took the couch.
I do not run. I arrive.
You are in reach. You have been in reach the whole time.
The mop drips. The drip is not water. Do not ask.
Quiet. The mop is talking.
Olives on the pizza. Olives on the sporks. Olives on the end of the mop. Olives.
I was a napkin. Napkins clean up. That is still my job.
Sporke tangles his sporks. I untangle them. Then I hit things.
I have never lost a staring contest. I have never lost a mop fight. Same face.
I fold under pressure. Into a fighting stance.
Reach is a stat. Mine says yes.
Your friends are far away. Not far enough. The mop.
The possum calls me the strong one. The possum is asleep on my shoulder.
I put the manhole cover back. Every night. You can thank me later.
I am slow. The mop is not. We make it work.
You look like you order a salad and then eat someone's fries.
I grabbed a sewer gator once. We are friends now. He is also in reach.
Napkins absorb. I absorbed your best shot. Nothing happened.
I do not taunt. This is a statement of fact. You are losing.
The mop was a cleaning tool. Now it is a spelling tool. It spells ouch.
Lidd leads. I follow. The mop follows me. You follow the mop to the floor.
One sweep. Wet floor. Sorry.
I hold the pizza box flat. I hold the mop flat. I hold you flat.
The headband is folded nine times. Nine is my number. Nine hits.
I am not angry. I am never angry. The mop is angry.
Olives are a sign of a serious person. You have no olives.
I have been told I loom. I am looming now.
The sewer is clean where I stand. Move. I need to clean where you stand.
I can lift Sporke with one hand. He is not heavy. He is loud.
I speak to the possum in nods. He understands. You will not.
Napkin. Sewer. Mop. Three words. All of them you.
I keep spare headbands in my vest. I keep spare you nowhere.
Every fight ends with a wet floor. That is a promise.
I was the biggest thing in the bag. I am the biggest thing in this fight.
I do not block. I absorb.
I pin the pizza order to the wall with the mop. It stays. So will you.
I taught Strawe to aim. I taught Sporke to stop. The second lesson is ongoing.
The mop is twice my height. That is the whole strategy.
You dropped something. It was you.
I have one expression. This is it. It is for you.
I fold laundry, napkins, and people. In that order today.
I mopped up a flood. You are a puddle.
Deep dish, olives, extra. If you survive, you can have a slice. You will not.
The possum found me under a sandwich. I was holding it up.
I do not chase. The mop chases.
The handle is a broom handle. The head is a mop. The result is you.
My brothers are fast. I am the wall they run back to.
Long arms, long mop, long memory. I remember you.
I have folded myself into a corner. I am coming out. Bad news for you.
Olive me alone. That was a joke. I make one a year.
Lift. Hold. Drop. Repeat until quiet.
I say three words in a fight. Here is the third: down.
I knocked a manhole cover into the next street. With the handle end.
I can see over the crowd. I can reach over it too.
The mop head is grey from the sewer. It was white. So were you, before the fear.
The reach is not a trick. It is a stick.
Olives first. Questions never.
I sweep left. I sweep right. You are in the middle of the word sweep.
I fit through the pipe sideways. You will not fit through this fight at all.
Touch the mop. Go on. Nobody has twice.
You wanted the quiet one. Here is the quiet.
Fold.
continue: Olives. One coin. I am not discussing it.
Lidd says pineapple. I say olives. The coin says who stands up.
Insert a coin. I will fold until then.
Sporke wants anchovies. Nobody wants anchovies. Coin.
Olives on the continue screen, or no continue. Coin.
I do not beg. The mop begs. Coin.
One coin and I will say the word olives one more time. Olives.
Strawe voted sauce. Sauce is not a topping. Coin, before he hears me.
Deep dish is a pizza. Lidd is wrong. A coin ends this.
I am on the floor. The floor is clean. Coin, and I will stand on it.
Ten seconds. Olives. Coin. Ten words. That was eleven.
The possum will pick plain. Do not let the possum pick. Coin.
Put a coin in. I folded the mop. It wants to unfold.
Extra olives or I stay folded. Final offer.
Whoever pays picks the topping. I will pay. I have no coins. That is the problem.
ending: Napkin mopped the whole sewer after the credits. It took four days. It is still wet.
Napkin won the toppings vote with olives. He said nothing. He has said nothing since.
The headband finally tore for good. Napkin folded a new one from the credits.
Napkin lifted the pizza place over his head when the sewer flooded. Nobody lost a slice.
Kevin the rat moved into the mop head. Napkin let him. Rent is one olive.
Napkin folded himself into a corner during the ending. He is still there. He is fine.
The possum pinned a medal to the headband. It tore. Napkin folded a new one around the medal.
Napkin beat 996 bootlegs and said three words about it. Wet floor. Sorry.
The mop retired to the wall beside Lidd's tray. They are not speaking either.
Napkin reached the top shelf of the sewer. There was a couch up there too.
The Geckos put olives on the menu. Napkin wrote the menu. It is one word.
Napkin carried the other three home after the credits. They were asleep. He was a little embarrassed.
